results.title: Edit a reading plan
results.checks: Library → Reading plans → Start a blank plan; Save waits for a reading; type Romans 8:28-39 into day 1, add a day with Psalm 23 and the chapter on screen, a nonsense reference is refused; move day 2 up and name it; offer Weekly; Save — the card shows the days in the new order, kept after a reload, with Start · Weekly

results.title: Add to plan from the verse toolbar
results.checks: While a reading plan is being edited, choosing John 3:16–17 offers Add to plan in the verse toolbar; with Day 2 being worked on it says 'Added to session 2' and Day 2 lists John 3:16–17
results.note: Add to plan appeared while editing; 'Added to session 2'; Day 2 listed John 3:16–17

results.title: A plan's day: text, a link and Reflect
results.checks: In a blank plan, Day 1 takes John 3, a few words ('Be still and know'), a link (a bad one says 'Enter a valid URL') and a Reflect note; saved, the plan's Day 1 shows the passage, the words, the link and Reflect with the note
results.note: Day 1 held John 3, the words, the link and its Reflect note
